summary: Phase 4 — Personalizzazione sito: 'Aspetto' (accent palette). BOTH backend (6/6 pytest) and frontend E2E verified. Regression on custom index.js entry: app boots cleanly on web, welcome gate renders, guest access + admin email/password login (pescatoridiuomini@outlook.it / Admin1234!) both work. Home / Podcast / Notizie / Palinsesto all open without crash or blank/red screen; 0 page errors. Backend: GET /api/site-settings returns `appearance` group; PUT /api/admin/site-settings {appearance:{palette:'teal'}} with admin token → 200 + reflected on public GET; PUT without auth or with invalid token → 401/403; appearance update is non-destructive (texts.home.brand_name preserved, sections group preserved); restore to 'sky' verified. Frontend admin: /admin/site Hub shows tile with testID `site-tile-Aspetto` (clickable → /admin/appearance); /admin/appearance renders all 7 palettes (testIDs `palette-sky|ocean|teal|sage|royal|amber|rose`), live preview, and `appearance-save` button. Selecting 'amber' + tapping 'Applica colore' → PUT succeeds, localStorage['pdu_appearance_palette']='amber', window.location.reload triggers, Home 'Consenti posizione' button (accent) turns amber/orange while navy backgrounds and white surfaces are unchanged. Persistence + fallback verified by then selecting 'sky' + saving → localStorage='sky' and Home accent returns to default azzurro. No React Native red screen, no deprecated packages surfaced by this feature.
critical_code_review_comments: index.js custom entry correctly awaits loadAndApplyCachedPalette() BEFORE requiring expo-router/entry, so StyleSheet.create calls see the mutated colors object. Well-scoped and non-invasive (0 per-screen refactor).

SiteTextsContext.tsx caches appearance.palette on every /site-settings fetch via cachePaletteKey → next launch picks up latest server-side value even if user never visited /admin/appearance from this device. Nice UX.

applyPalette mutates only the 4 brand tokens (brandPrimary/Secondary/Tertiary/onBrandTertiary); surface/navy/text tokens untouched → confirmed visually on Home (backgrounds & text unchanged, only accent shifts).
admin/appearance.tsx uses Platform.OS === 'web' + window.location.reload after save → verified: after tap the page reloads and the new accent is active app-wide.
palettes.ts: 7 curated palettes with sensible on/tertiary contrasts; sky is the default and matches the current theme.ts baseline exactly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — regression clean, palette switch amber↔sky verified with localStorage + visual accent confirmation

seed_data_creation: Non-persistent: appearance.palette was set to 'teal', then 'amber', then restored to 'sky' at teardown (both via pytest fixture and via the admin UI). texts.home.brand_name TEST_BRAND_PDU_P4 cleared in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 Aspetto fully green. Admin creds: pescatoridiuomini@outlook.it / Admin1234!. Palette cache key: 'pdu_appearance_palette' in localStorage on web. Web save triggers window.location.reload — Playwright must page.on('dialog', accept) if any alert appears (in this build none fired since reload path is taken).
